structured_output.title: New opt-in ingress-shim flag that this environment doesn't set
structured_output.content: The release note describes a newly added ingress-shim option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which copies listed annotation keys from Ingress-like resources to the resulting Certificate. None of the 4 values keys set in this environment (global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled, prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort, replicaCount) configures this option or any controller arguments. The manifests in use list only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, and no Ingress-like resource that ingress-shim would act on. Because the option is new and nothing here sets it, it doesn't reach this environment unless the operator chooses to adopt it. If Ingress-based certificates exist outside the supplied manifests, the operator should check this before deciding.
